title: Generate exact bounded rational Stein coefficients
body:
I implement exact rational bounded Stein generators at PR4100's Gaussian dirty-shear coefficient interface. For each nonzero orthogonal residual v, I choose a dyadic c with `||v||₂<=c<2||v||₂`, then emit `g=v/c` and the explicit row `a=(c/(v^*v)) v^*E`, where `v^*` denotes conjugate transpose. I obtain `E=sum g*a`, exactly `rank(E)` terms, `||g||₂<=1` and `||a||₂<2||E||₂`, using rational complex arithmetic and exact rank decisions.

The source already gives a polynomial-time route through rational Gram–Schmidt and approximate square-root normalization. I refine that construction with an implemented rational producer and explicit bounds; I do not report irrational normalization as a gap. I follow the numerical source's coefficient-row convention and make its relation to the adjoint-column notation explicit.

For an m-by-m input with component height b, I prove the conservative preprocessing bound `4096*(m+1)^6*(b+1)`, including the finite inverse-series coefficients. I choose an adaptive dyadic Gamma so `P=I+U(a)/Gamma` meets the retained triangular child's near-identity condition on dyadic tiles. I prove a polynomial macro-prefix/inverse-prefix bound using additive completed shears, preserving the generator count and the conditional source depth. Offline encodings and online word widths remain separate.

I authenticate the actual retained exact Schur producer and collect 50 shears from 25 recursive nodes. Six additional stress fixtures give 56 matrices in total, 67 generators and 268 macro stages. I extract the seven-statement tail of the source's `lowdisp_shear`, retain its order and reversed source indices, and replace SVD/scale selection with the rational producer. Exact matrix callbacks verify displacement/product reconstruction, independent rank, complete dirty-source restoration, inverse-prefix identities and the norm envelope.

Controls retain a `2^-200` independent residual and reject a dropped tiny term, extra complex conjugation, omitted compensation, omitted source restoration, zero normalization, floating input and source corruption. I compare the complete typed receipt. The largest observed component/named-norm/final-scale height is 801 bits; this measurement does not instrument every internal Fraction temporary. The separate written proof supplies the universal height bound.

At `e457d5e912a27307d725827aeca7198169320b84`, both registered ordinary/optimized commands pass. I passed the 15-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity and both Git-free commands in 0.770 and 0.772 seconds. All 16 export files, including the receipt, remained unchanged. Export SHA256: `66c3c8a41eea3544045c605d9cd5a6a6d87c347f1575ab2afdf6381a18baafc0`; receipt SHA256: `01f7fed65046ce9889fdffd9f1d6a977ab10fef371690d48b2508de7846e1478`; scientific receipt: `92a829e20db5c338531152f2dcf75ff940789cc72ccf2fe34f8c8ffd6a9303fd`.

I matched both successful [hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39431782595) records to that export and checked the successful unchanged-input step. Test merge `483f4e0c2605f87d7ec034334dd51720ff2761e9` has the published tree `ed2334c1d066279a9cc996c6607f39c7e7f09d46`.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rational-stein-generators
```

I add only `research/rational-stein-generators/`, refining the `uniform-transfer-audit` card at priority 7. I start from canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` and pin PR4100 at `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`. I refreshed unchanged main, source feedback, 60 recent PRs and 10/696 hub comments before publication. [Discussion4196](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4196) retains the initial 100-PR/35-comment check, source reviews and bounded local overlap search. PR4195's CRT rows and PR4197's compensation forests address separate obligations.

I replay source macros with exact matrix callbacks, not FFT/butterfly or triangular child gates. The package's next questions concern certified rounded child execution and delivery into the actual coefficient-page/error-budget interface. Full circuit correctness, physical execution and complete multiplication-theorem acceptance remain separate. I leave the selected frontier unchanged.
